experiment: independent finite-row 3VL interpretation of Catalyst analyzed plan, rather than optimizer-vs-optimizer SQL oracle
previous_baseline: Current automatic order+TopK QueryProof 0/3 B01,B02,B03 reproduced independent family bugs. A single rule ablation gave 1/3. Preserve these baselines.
stage1_contract: A strictly supported analyzed INNER JOIN of two direct immutable in-memory or Parquet named views and identity Project of join attributes, join condition a supported deterministic 3VL Boolean expression (Not,And,Or,EqualTo,EqualNullSafe,IsNull,IsNotNull). Evaluate over independently read small left/right raw relations (max 16 rows each) in Python without executing an equivalent Spark join. If other operators, transformations, aliases, unsupported types or ambiguous mapping, UNKNOWN.
stage2_contract: Single nullable IN subquery in Filter/Project, with one exposed source column and one direct source subquery, no correlated expressions, 3VL semantics. Treat unsupported as UNKNOWN.
original_benchmark: tools/queryproof_prospective/manifest.json existing selection_date 2026-10-16; historical bugs B01,B02,B03 previously studied and therefore these are IN-SAMPLE calibration, NOT a new blind benchmark
predeclared_controls: No SQL predicate, or unsupported join or unsupported expression returns UNKNOWN
Synthetic NOT and IS NULL contexts over distinct and null values
Do not claim correct for any unsupported SQL type or nondeterministic predicate
reported_metrics: fully automated coverage on selected cases
genuine row-bag mismatches against independently evaluated analyzed semantics
source and comparison cost relative to Spark execution
novelty: Implementation and proof-of-concept only. Formal 3VL semantics and finite SQL interpreters have extensive prior art; require new independent holdout and competitive baseline before claiming scientific contribution.
